posts.topic: Profile visitors who don't follow: 4 profile fixes
hook_options: Log profile pe aate hain, par follow nahi karte
Tumhara bio followers bhaga raha hai
4 profile galtiyan jo follow rokti hain

slides.hook_sub: 4 profile galtiyan aur unka simple fix
slides.visual: PhotoCover 4:5 with Karan's real rooftop photo, warm grade, headline top third in cream, red line = hook_red

slides.title: Naya visitor profile ko deta hai
slides.body: Usme woh 3 cheezein dekhta hai: naam, bio aur pinned posts. Teeno clear nahi, toh scroll. Yeh slide akeli bhi kaam ki hai: abhi apna profile kholo.
slides.visual: White ground, red serif 02, mock profile header wireframe (no real account)

slides.title: Galti 1: Naam mein sirf naam
slides.body: Name field mein kaam bhi likho. 'Karan | AI & Marketing' se visitor ko turant pata chalta hai tum kya sikhate ho.
slides.visual: Sand ground, before/after name field in two simple boxes

slides.title: Galti 2: Bio mein sirf vibes
slides.body: Bio ek line mein bataye: kiske liye ho, kya milega, next step kya hai. Example: 'Beginners ke liye AI + marketing workflows. Free resource →'
slides.visual: White ground, bio text block with red arrow only

slides.title: Galti 3: Pinned posts random
slides.body: Top 3 pinned posts tumhara intro hain: 1 best value post, 1 tumhari story, 1 proof. Proof sirf real ho, banaya hua nahi.
slides.visual: Sand ground, 3 square placeholders labelled Value / Story / Proof

slides.title: Galti 4: Bio link mein 10 options
slides.body: Visitor confuse hua toh kuch click nahi karega. Ek main action: free resource, WhatsApp ya call. Baaki baad mein.
slides.visual: White ground, 10 tiny link pills crossed to 1 clear pill

slides.cta_body: Comment "AI" — 4-point profile checklist DM mein bhej dunga.
slides.visual: Espresso ground, cream Comment "AI" pill with red up-arrow, handle footer

posts.caption:
Instagram profile tips jo visitors ko followers banate hain 👇

Zyada log reels pe mehnat karte hain, par jab koi profile pe aata hai toh wahan kuch clear hi nahi hota. Naam mein sirf naam, bio mein sirf vibes, pinned posts random.

Is carousel mein 4 galtiyan aur unka fix hai. Ek kaam karo: slide 2 padhte hi apna profile kholo aur khud check karo — 2 minute lagenge.

posts.caption:
Comment to DM automation Instagram pe kaise kaam karta hai — simple language mein 👇

Tumne dekha hoga: kisi post pe 'AI' comment karo aur turant DM aa jaata hai. Yeh koi jaadu nahi, ek automation hai.

1. Post pe ek keyword decide karo
2. Ek Meta-approved automation tool us keyword wale comment ko detect karta hai
3. Tool khud DM mein tumhara resource bhej deta hai

Tum so rahe ho, leads DM mein aa rahi hain. Bas ek rule: jo promise kiya, wahi bhejo.

posts.topic: 3 WhatsApp follow-up messages for new leads
hook_options: Ad chala, lead aayi, phir kya?
Yeh 3 message lead ko thanda hone se bachate hain

slides.hook_sub: Small business ke liye copy-paste WhatsApp follow-ups
slides.visual: Type cover on white, serif hook, red punch line, footer Swipe →

slides.title: Ek follow-up nahi kiya,
slides.body: Form bharne ke baad log 2-3 aur options bhi check karte hain. Jo pehle aur clearly reply kare, baat usi se aage badhti hai.
slides.visual: Sand ground, red serif 02, simple chat bubble outline

slides.title: Message 1: Turant
slides.body: "Hi [Naam], [Business] mein interest ke liye thanks! Aapko [product] kis kaam ke liye chahiye?" Ek sawaal = reply karna aasaan.
slides.visual: White ground, chat bubble with template, brackets in clay

slides.title: Message 2: Agle din
slides.body: "[Naam], aapke sawaal ka short answer: [1 useful tip ya price range]. Chaho toh 5 minute call kar lein?"
slides.visual: Sand ground, chat bubble with template

slides.title: Message 3: Teesre din
slides.body: "Bas check kar raha tha, abhi bhi [product] dekh rahe ho? Na ho toh bhi bata dena, main list update kar dunga."
slides.visual: White ground, chat bubble with template

slides.title: 3 rules jo
slides.body: Naam se baat karo. Har message mein ek hi sawaal. Teen ke baad ruk jao. Sirf unhe message karo jinhone number khud diya ho.
slides.visual: Sand ground, three short lines, red serif numbers

slides.cta_body: Comment "AI" — editable WhatsApp follow-up sheet DM mein bhej dunga.
slides.visual: Espresso ground, cream Comment "AI" pill with red up-arrow

posts.caption:
WhatsApp follow up messages for leads — copy-paste templates 👇

Ad pe paisa lagaya, lead bhi aayi... phir reply hi nahi kiya, ya ek 'Hi' bhej ke chhod diya. Yahi jagah hai jahan zyada small businesses leads kho dete hain.

Is carousel mein 3 messages hain: turant, agle din aur teesre din. Brackets mein apni details daalo aur bhejo. Ek zaroori baat: sirf unhe message karo jinhone khud number diya hai.

Comment "AI" — editable follow-up sheet DM mein bhej dunga.

posts.linkedin_post:
Leads aati hain, par follow-up nahi hota — small businesses ka sabse sasta leak yahi hai.

Mera simple 3-message system:
1. Turant: thanks + ek sawaal
2. Agle din: ek useful answer + call ka option
3. Teesre din: soft close

Rules: naam se baat, ek message mein ek sawaal, teen ke baad stop, aur sirf opted-in leads.

Templates chahiye toh comment karo "AI".
